title: Rationalization of bounded-below classical-adic complexes lies in the supported model hull
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its ring of integers $O=\mathcal O_F$, and a uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Give $O,F$ their valuation topologies and write $O^c(P)=C(P,O)$ and $F^c(P)=C(P,F)$ for their condensed rings of all continuous functions on profinite sets [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. On its small pro-étale site in the fixed universes put $O_X=p_X^*O^c$, $F_X=p_X^*F^c$, and $k_{n,X}=(O/\pi^n)_X$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Use the ordinary uncompleted internal-module derived categories, and K-flat derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $\nu_X:X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}\to X_{\mathrm{\acute et}}$ be the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

Suppose $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{O_X})$ is bounded below, meaning $H^i(K)=0$ for all $i<a$ for some integer $a$. Suppose its canonical derived-completion unit is an isomorphism,
$$K\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{O_X}k_{n,X}),$$
with the actual quotient transitions [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. For each $n$, assume there is a bounded-below complex $C_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{\acute et}},O/\pi^n)$ and an isomorphism $\nu_X^*C_n\cong K\otimes^L_{O_X}k_{n,X}$, interpreted in internal finite-coefficient coordinates by [lem-sf-module-object-ordinary-coefficient-equivalence]. No constructibility or finite generation of the cohomology of $C_n$ is required, and no simultaneous descent of the tower to a single étale object is assumed.

Then
$$F_X\otimes^L_{O_X}K\ \in\ \mathcal G_X(F^c),$$
where $\mathcal G_X(F^c)$ is exactly the supported model hull of [def-sfb-supported-model-hull], with its ordinary derived products and strict filtered-colimit closure with a common termwise lower bound. No change to a completed, solidified or restricted ambient category is made. There is no morphism of schemes in the hypothesis, and no cohomological-dimension, characteristic, invertibility-of-$\ell$, Noetherianity or finite-type hypothesis. Empty schemes and $K=0$ are included.
